title: Lost eternity
description: Lost eternity is a world generation mod that adds unique surface buildings and dangerous underground dungeons with traps, enemies, and great loot.
body:
Lost Eternity upgrades Minecraft's survival experience with challenging, trap-heavy dungeons designed to turn passive exploration into tactical combat encounters.

​The Ice Camp: A snowy surface landmark hiding a deep, frozen basement layout. Features pressure-plate traps and ice skeletons.

​The Forest House: An abandoned woodland shack built directly over a massive, secret underground bunker complex.

​The Savannah Dungeon: A giant subterranean maze packed with zombie spawners, perfect for mid-to-late game gear testing.

​All structures generate naturally and support the standard /locate structure command.
